user.title: Template Forecast
user.description: Name and mode for the new forecast helper.

transform_source.title: Source entity
transform_source.description: Entity whose list attribute should be transformed.

generate.title: Planning horizon & templates
generate.description: Builds a new forecast list by evaluating the attribute template once per step across the planning horizon below.

data_description.state_template_info_generate_content: Defines the value shown as the sensor's own state. Available: `forecast`, the already computed result list from the attribute template below, e.g. `forecast[0].value`.

data_description.attribute_template_info_generate_content:
Evaluated once per time step to build the forecast list. Available: `index` (0-based step), `horizon` (total number of steps), `forecast_time` (datetime of this step, UTC). To set multiple fields per entry, such as a custom time, return an object instead:
```
'{{ {"time": forecast_time.isoformat(), "value": 10 + index, "condition": "sunny"} }}'
```

transform.title: Templates
transform.description:
Evaluates the attribute template once per item of the source entity's list, producing a new forecast list.

Source entity: {source_entity}

data_description.state_template_info_transform_content: Defines the value shown as the sensor's own state. Available: `forecast` (already computed result list), `source` (state of the source entity), `source_forecast` (original list before the transformation).

data_description.attribute_template_info_transform_conten:
Evaluated once per item of the source list, to build the new forecast list. Available: `index` (position in the source list), `item` (the complete original element from the source list), `value` (`item.value`, if present). To merge extra fields into the item, such as adding a condition alongside the doubled value, return an object instead:
```
'{{ {"value": value * 2, "condition": "sunny"} }}'
```

error.attribute_template_render_error: Attribute template failed on a test render: {attribute_template_error}
error.state_template_render_error: State template failed on a test render: {state_template_error}
